ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 95% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels restricted to the peduncle junction and trailing edge perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region occupying the central and distal lobe areas; localized low-intensity vertical cluster at the inferior peduncle interface; thin low-intensity linear boundary along the superior trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation with an estimated angle of 145 degrees; vertical notch depth is approximately 3% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrated profile with micro-peaks (2-4 pixel amplitude) distributed along the entire superior trailing edge; increased irregularity and macro-texture on the distal left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curve ascending from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in jagged horizontal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-texture, high-contrast white nodular clusters (barnacle colonies) concentrated on the distal terminal tip of the left lobe and scattered along the leading edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation (barnacle colonization) localized on the terminal left tip, creating a distinct macro-textural deformation of the fluke boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: A localized low-intensity vertical pigmentation mark located at the midline junction of the fluke and peduncle.
